tasks.description: Freeze the Detail numerical contract in an independent reference with synthetic fixtures and quality gates.
extra_context: Start from the design's baseline (Algorithms and numerics): difference-form B3 denoise with k_j = [0.8914, 0.1992, 0.0860], T_L = 0.05*(luminance/100)^1.5*k_j, T_C = 0.04*(colour/100)^1.5*k_j, 3x3 protection, non-negative garrote; Gaussian unsharp residual with coring theta = 0.01*(1 - sharpen-detail/100)^2, gradient masking guide and tanh 3x3 limiter at delta = 0.04*(hi - lo). Tune within it; do not change scope, stage or the two-unit contract.

Formulation is fixed: difference-form smoothing x + sum_{i!=0} w_i (x_{p+ih} - x_p) with taps in the order -2,-1,+1,+2; output equals input when delta-lab is zero bit for bit; achromatic snap |a'|,|b'| <= NEUTRAL_CHROMA_SNAP (1e-6) gives [L'^3; 3]; otherwise from_oklab.

Proxy rule is fixed: per-axis sampled normalized Gaussians sigma' = h_j*s (h = 1,2,4), R' = max(1, ceil(3 sigma')), weights normalized in f64; sharpen sigma' = radius*s; guide and limiter windows max(1, ceil(r*s)); halo' = sum_j R'_j + 1 (denoise) and max(R'_s, R'_guide + 1, 1) (sharpen). The study measures and freezes its error bound; it does not choose another rule.

Chroma contingency is pre-decided: if the correlated-chroma gate fails with three levels, adopt a fourth chroma-only level at spacing 8, raise DETAIL_DENOISE_HALO_MAX to 32 (operation cap 48 px) and record it in the design and study. No other scale change.

The reference crate imports no workspace crate (repository rule independent-references). Numeric probes from the design review (8-bit vs float hand-off banding, Oklab identity costs, proxy rule errors, cost estimates) are the expected orders of magnitude; the study reproduces its own figures.

The reference and implementation prototype are frozen. The sigma-16 chroma, moving-proxy p99 and noisy-ramp neighbour gates fail explicitly; moving their pass requirement to photographic/production qualification TASK-013 does not relax any threshold or authorize broader kernels or a revised metric.

tasks.description: Move every pixel read through a spatial prefix off the catalog owner: queries on the point worker, mutations owner to point worker to owner.
extra_context: Owner decision (2026-09-30): no pixel work on the owner and no rule-5 exception. One mechanism covers the JPEG neutral picker, mask.sample-input, the colour-limited brush seed and any planning read (pixel set) through a spatial prefix.

Deferral: HostStage::sample_before keeps its per-index compiled prefix. When compiled.evaluates_spatial() and the context's PixelMemo lacks the answer, record PixelRead { index, x, y } in EditorService's deferred_read slot (RefCell<Option<DeferredRead>>) and return an internal error. The owner checks the slot after every handler; a recorded read wins over the handler's result. A prefix without a spatial layer is answered on the owner as today.

Queries: a deferred query becomes Planned::Query(Box<QueryPlan>) holding an owned exact editor Evaluation, the resolved query (module or host), checked parameters, target and view. The point worker runs it with WorkerStage: StageQuestions over that evaluation, keeping one point Evaluation (SpatialMode::Point) per prefix index for the whole query so the 25-point neutral patch shares one tile cache. mask.sample-input answers from MaskInputPixel::linear of the prefix evaluation (full precision on a wide byte frame). Answers go to the caller with the planning sequence, as samples do.

Mutations: park the call as ParkedRead { client, request, response, key: PixelReadKey, rounds } and submit a PointCall that posts OwnerMessage::PixelsRead { ticket, result } back to the owner. PixelReadKey = { asset_id, entry_id, asset revision, draft id and draft revision or none, prefix_hash, source fingerprint and development }. On receipt: equal key -> install answers as the call's PixelMemo and run the request again; unequal -> discard and run again (defers anew). MAX_PIXEL_READ_ROUNDS = 4: exceeded after a key change is `conflict` ("the stack changed while its pixels were read; retry"), exceeded with answered rounds is `resource-limit`. Record a retried request only when finally answered.

Draft memo: Session::pixel_memo (not a serialized Draft field), at most MAX_PIXEL_MEMO = 32 answers keyed by PixelReadKey + (index, x, y); cleared by draft.begin, draft.reapply, draft.cancel, commit and any key change. A colour-limited stroke reads its seed once per draft; commit planning answers from the memo.

Point worker: parked reads and queries share POINT_QUEUE_CAPACITY; the refusal text names "point samples, queries or pixel reads". PointCall gains cancel: Cancel, tripped by disconnect for the running call; disconnect also drops the client's parked reads. Estimate-miss reductions stay serial.
Tests use the restoration test provider from the stage task (or Presence stored before the sampled layer). Every test name contains `restoration` or `point`.

tasks.description: Add the settle policy, restoration reporting and prefix boundary, and the 16-bit byte-path hand-off shared with Presence.
extra_context: Owner decision (2026-09-30): on the byte path a spatial frame feeding a colour run or another spatial unit is 16-bit encoded sRGB; 8-bit quantization only at a resample, a point replacement or the terminal. This settles Presence's JPEG precision too; this task implements it for both and re-validates Presence.

Settle policy: EffectDescriptor.fit_settle: FitSettle { #[default] Proxy, Exact } with #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = default, rename_all = "kebab-case")]. SpatialEntry carries its layer's stage and whether its effect declares Exact. Compiled::settles_from_exact() is true only for a non-empty entry declaring Exact.

Reporting: ProxyApproximation gains restoration: bool (non-empty restoration entry) with reason "a restoration layer's full-resolution filters run on averaged proxy pixels"; spatial counts spatial-stage entries only.

Prefix boundary (used by both caches): ModuleRegistry::restoration_prefix(layers) -> usize = length of the leading run of source, pixel and restoration layers; Compiled::restoration_boundary() -> Option<usize> = the segment whose input frame is that prefix's output, Some only when the prefix holds a non-empty restoration operation.

Byte hand-off: colour::srgb::decode16_table() (65,536 f32, built once, entries at 257*c bit-identical to decode_table()[c]) and quantize16(f32) -> u16 (exact f64-derived thresholds, one definition). Byte::Pixel = [u16; 3] (8-bit values stored as 257*code). ByteFrame { Narrow(Arc<Vec<u8>>) RGBA8, Wide(Arc<Vec<u16>>) RGB16 }. byte_frame_widths(&Compiled) implements the design's four rules and is read by rasterize, the point path and the grid. segment_pass and SegmentRows become generic over the frame sample type; a wide segment holds chunk rows as f32 between load and store. Add a u16 frame_mut sibling with the same frame_writes instrumentation. Wide length = w*h*6, checked against MAX_FRAME_BYTES.

Memory: byte peak stays two frames, a wide one 1.5x a narrow one (24 MP: at most 275 MiB; 64 MP JPEG limit: at most 732 MiB). No timing here; the performance task measures Presence on JPEG before and after.
Update docs/design/presence-study.md and the Presence design's current-behaviour text to the delivered hand-off when this lands; record any re-frozen byte literal's reason in its test.
Focused implementation is present; native journey evidence is consolidated in TASK-016 and remains required there before qualification is complete.

extra_context: Owner decision (2026-09-30); a cache under performance rule 14 (docs/engineering/performance-rules.md). New file crates/luxforge-core/src/preview/prefix.rs: RestorationPrefixKey { proxy: ProxyKey, prefix_hash: String, domain: String }, RestorationPrefixFrame { key, held: Region, pixels: Wide(Arc<Vec<u16>>) | Linear(Arc<Vec<f32>>), bytes: u64 }, RestorationPrefixCache (one entry), PrefixUse { Built, Reused, TooLarge }, RESTORATION_PREFIX_MAX_BYTES = 128 MiB.
